if(sum(grep("bear", species, ignore.case = T))>0|sum(grep("bjorn", species, ignore.case = T))>0){

if(sum(grep("wolf", species, ignore.case = T))>0|sum(grep("ulv", species, ignore.case = T))>0){
  engSpecies <- "wolf"
  norSpecies <- "Ulv"
}
if(sum(grep("wolverine", species, ignore.case = T))>0|sum(grep("jerv", species, ignore.case = T))>0){
  engSpecies <- "wolverine"
  norSpecies <- "Jerv"
} else {
  engSpecies <- species
  norSpecies <- species
} 

##-- Load pre-processed habitat shapefiles
data(COUNTRIESWaterHumans, envir = environment())

  dplyr::group_by(ISO) %>%
  dplyr::summarise()
```

# Introduction

This document summarizes the data preparation process of the **`r species`** DNA data available from [RovBase 3.0](https://rovbase.no/), for analysis with a SCR model as done by the [AQEG team](https://www.nmbu.no/en/projects/rovquant). This document refers to the preparation and formatting of the **`r species`** data collected during the monitoring period **`r seasons`**.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Habitat definition

```{r, load habitat, echo = FALSE}
##-- Load prepared habitat
load(file.path( working.dir, "data",
                paste0("Habitat_", engSpecies, "_", date, ".RData")))

##-- Identify number of habitat covariates
covNames <- names(habitat$grid)[!names(habitat$grid) %in% c("Habitat","id", "x","y","geometry")]
L <- length(covNames)
```

The habitat, sometimes called state-space, describes the space available for the placement of individual activity centers. A `r habitat$resolution/1000`-km habitat grid with a total of `r  habitat$n.habwindows` cells was prepared for the `r species` SCR analysis. The habitat considered in this SCR analysis thus covers an area of `r  habitat$n.habwindows * (habitat$resolution/1000)^2` $km^{2}$.

Spatial covariates are used in the density sub-model of the SCR.  `r L` habitat covariates (matching the habitat grid) were prepared for the `r species` SCR analysis.

```{r, hab grid, echo = FALSE, fig.align = "center",fig.cap = "Figure 1: Habitat characteristics"}
if(length(covNames) <= 0){
  mapview( x = habitat$grid[ ,"Habitat"],
           legend = FALSE,
           layer.name =  "Habitat",        
           map.types = c( "OpenStreetMap.DE",
                          "OpenTopoMap",
                          "Esri.WorldShadedRelief")) 
} else {
  mapview( x = habitat$grid[ ,"Habitat"],
           legend = FALSE,
           layer.name =  "Habitat",        
           map.types = c( "OpenStreetMap.DE",
                          "OpenTopoMap",
                          "Esri.WorldShadedRelief")) +
    mapview( x = habitat$grid,
             hide = TRUE,
             legend = FALSE,
             alpha.regions = 0.9,
             zcol = c(covNames))
}
```

The prepared habitat layers are available in: `r file.path(working.dir, "data", paste0("Habitat_", engSpecies, "_", date, ".RData"))`

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Detectors definition

```{r, load detectors grid, echo = FALSE}
##-- Load prepared detectors
load(file.path( working.dir, "data",
                paste0("Detectors_", engSpecies, "_", date, ".RData")))

##-- Identify number of detector covariates
covNames <- names(detectors$grid)[!names(detectors$grid) %in% c("Detector","id", "x","y","geometry")]
covNames <- covNames[!grepl("[0-9]", covNames) | grepl(years[length(years)], covNames)]
L <- length(covNames)
```

The surveyed area, also called detector-space, describes the region that was searched for `r species` DNA samples during non-invasive genetic monitoring. Although the area searched is continuous, it is discretized for practical reasons in the model. A `r detectors$resolution/1000`-km resolution detector grid was prepared for the `r species` SCR analysis.

The area surveyed is defined based on a pre-determined extent containing the entire population range of the species in the countries of interest.

It is composed of `r detectors$n.detectors` detector grid cells, each of size `r (detectors$resolution/1000)^2` $km^{2}$, leading to a total surveyed area of `r detectors$n.detectors*(detectors$resolution/1000)^2` $km^{2}$.

In order to better capture the variation in detection probability throughout the landscape as a result of e.g. a variation in search effort, spatial covariates can be used in the detection sub-model of the SCR. `r L` detector covariates (matching the detector grid) were prepared for the `r species` SCR analysis.

```{r, det grid, echo = FALSE, fig.align = "center", fig.cap = "Figure 2: Detector characteristics"}
if(length(covNames) <= 0){
  mapview( x = detectors$grid[ ,"id"],
           legend = FALSE,
           layer.name =  "Main detectors",        
           map.types = c( "OpenStreetMap.DE",
                          "OpenTopoMap",
                          "Esri.WorldShadedRelief")) 
} else {
  mapview( x = detectors$grid[ ,"id"],
           legend = FALSE,
           layer.name =  "Main detectors",        
           map.types = c( "OpenStreetMap.DE",
                          "OpenTopoMap",
                          "Esri.WorldShadedRelief"))  +
    mapview( x = detectors$grid,
             hide = TRUE,
             legend = FALSE,
             alpha.regions = 0.9,
             lwd = 0.2,
             zcol = c(covNames))
}
```

The prepared detector layers are available in: `r file.path(working.dir, "data", paste0("Detectors_", engSpecies, "_", date, ".RData"))`

# Rovbase data

```{r, data, echo = FALSE, fig.align = "center"}
fileList <- list.files(file.path(working.dir, "data")) 
fileName <- fileList[grep(paste0("CleanData_",engSpecies,"_"), fileList)]
extractDate <- sub("^.*_(.*)\\.RData$", "\\1",  fileName)

load(file.path( working.dir, "data",
                paste0("FilteredData_", engSpecies, "_", date, ".RData")))
```

Data from multiple sources are necessary for the SCR analysis, the primary one being the Scandinavian large carnivore database [RovBase 3.0](https://rovbase.no/) (rovbase.se and rovbase.no; last extraction: `r extractDate`). Data collected during the `r seasons`  monitoring seasons were used in this analysis.

## Non-invasive genetic samples

```{r, ngs data, echo = FALSE, collapse = TRUE}
ngs <- data.alive$data.sp %>% 
  filter(Year %in% years)

##-- Number of NGS samples collected per country
percCountry <- table(ngs$Country_sample)
percCountry <- round(percCountry[2]/sum(percCountry)*100)


##-- Number of NGS samples collected per sex and per year 
numDet_sexYear <- table(ngs$Sex,ngs$Year)
colnames(numDet_sexYear) <- "number of \nNGS samples"
numDet_sexYear <- rbind(numDet_sexYear, colSums(numDet_sexYear))
rownames(numDet_sexYear) <- c(sex,"Total")

##-- Number of individuals detected per sex and per year
numId_sexYear <- apply(table(ngs$Id,ngs$Sex,ngs$Year) > 0, c(2,3), sum)
colnames(numId_sexYear) <- "number of \nindividuals detected"
numId_sexYear <- rbind(numId_sexYear,colSums(numId_sexYear))
rownames(numId_sexYear) <- c(sex,"Total")

numIdSamples <- cbind(numDet_sexYear,numId_sexYear)

##-- Number of NGS samples per individual per year
df <- ngs %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarize(., 
            freq = n(),
            .by = c(Id,Sex,Year))

mu <- summarize( df, 
                 grp.mean = mean(freq),
                 .by = Sex)

```{r, ngs timeSeries, fig.align = "center", fig.cap = paste0("Figure 3: ", species, " non-invasive genetic samples collected in Norway between ", seasons[1], " and ", seasons[length(seasons)], "."), echo = FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(working.dir, "figures/NGS_SCR_maps.png"))
```

A total of `r numDet_sexYear["Total"]` (`r numDet_sexYear["female"]` female; `r numDet_sexYear["male"]` male) genotyped `r species` genetic samples were included in the analysis, of which `r percCountry`% originated from Sweden. These samples were associated with `r numId_sexYear["Total"]` (`r numId_sexYear["female"]` female; `r numId_sexYear["male"]` male) individuals. We did not include individuals with unknown sex in this analysis.

```{r, data table, echo = FALSE, collapse = TRUE}
kable( numIdSamples, 
       align = "cc",
       caption = paste0("Number of ", species," non-invasive genetic samples and individuals detected included in the SCR analysis. We included only samples collected within the study area during the primary monitoring period ", seasons, ".")) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = F)
```

The number of detections per individual varied from 1 to `r max(df$freq)`, with a mean number of NGS detections of `r round(mu$grp.mean[1],2)` for females and `r round(mu$grp.mean[2],2)` for males.

# Nimble input

```{r, load input, echo = FALSE}
load(file.path( working.dir, "nimbleInFiles/SCR/male",
                paste0("SCRinput", years, "_", date, "_male_1.RData")))
nimData_M <- nimData

load(file.path( working.dir, "nimbleInFiles/SCR/female",
                paste0("SCRinput", years, "_", date, "_female_1.RData")))
nimData_F <- nimData
```

This data is then formatted for use in the following Nimble model:

```{r, nimble model, echo = FALSE}
modelCode
```


```{r, nimble data, echo = FALSE}
if(engSpecies == "bear"){
  ##-- Number of detections used 
  detsPerYear_F <- apply(nimData_F$y.alive,c(1,3), function(x){
    ifelse(x[1] > 0, sum(x[2:(x[1]+1)]), 0)
  })
  detsPerYear_M <- apply(nimData_M$y.alive,c(1,3), function(x){
    ifelse(x[1] > 0, sum(x[2:(x[1]+1)]), 0)
  })
  
  ##-- Number of sub-detectors "activated"
  numSamples_sexYear <- rbind(colSums(detsPerYear_F), colSums(detsPerYear_M))
  if(length(dim(numSamples_sexYear)) > 1){
    numSamples_sexYear <- cbind(numSamples_sexYear,rowSums(numSamples_sexYear))
    colnames(numSamples_sexYear) <- c(seasons,"Total")
    numSamples_sexYear <- rbind(numSamples_sexYear,colSums(numSamples_sexYear))
    rownames(numSamples_sexYear) <- c(sex,"Total")
  }
  kable( numSamples_sexYear, 
         align = "lc",
         caption = paste0("Annual number of ", species," individual detections included in the analysis. Numbers are reported by sex and for each monitoring. One detection consists in at least one NGS detection of a given individual in a sub-detector grid cell and may thus correspond to multiple DNA samples collected. We included only samples collected within the study area during the primary monitoring period between ", seasons[1], " and ", seasons[length(seasons)], ".")) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = F)
  
  
  ##-- Number of individuals used 
  numIds_sexYear <- rbind(colSums(detsPerYear_F > 0), colSums(detsPerYear_M > 0))
  if(length(dim(numSamples_sexYear)) > 1){
    numIds_sexYear <- cbind(numIds_sexYear,rowSums(numIds_sexYear))
    colnames(numIds_sexYear) <- c(seasons,"Total")
    numIds_sexYear <- rbind(numIds_sexYear,colSums(numIds_sexYear))
    rownames(numIds_sexYear) <- c(sex,"Total")
  }
  kable( numId_sexYear,
         align = "lc",
         caption = paste0("Annual number of individual ", species,"  detected via non-invasive genetic sampling and included in the OPSCR analysis. Numbers are reported by sex and for each monitoring period. We included only individuals associated with samples collected within the study area during the primary monitoring period between ", seasons[1], " and ", seasons[length(seasons)], ".")) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = F)
}

if(engSpecies == "wolverine"){
  
  ##-- Number of detections used 
  detsPerYear_F <- apply(nimData_F$y,1, function(x){
    ifelse(x[1] > 0, sum(x[x>0]), 0)
  })
  detsPerYear_F.Oth <- apply(nimData_F$y.Oth,1, function(x){
    ifelse(x[1] > 0, sum(x[x>0]), 0)
  })
  detsPerYear_M <- apply(nimData_M$y,1, function(x){
    ifelse(x[1] > 0, sum(x[x>0]), 0)
  })
  detsPerYear_M.Oth <- apply(nimData_M$y.Oth,1, function(x){
    ifelse(x[1] > 0, sum(x[x>0]), 0)
  })
  
  ##-- Number of sub-detectors "activated"
  numSamples_sexYear <- c(sum(detsPerYear_F),
                          sum(detsPerYear_M),
                          sum(detsPerYear_F.Oth),
                          sum(detsPerYear_M.Oth))
  ##-- Total number of detections
  numSamples_sexYear <- c(numSamples_sexYear, sum(numSamples_sexYear))
  
  ##-- Number of individuals used 
  numIds_sexYear <- c(sum(detsPerYear_F>0),
                      sum(detsPerYear_M>0),
                      sum(detsPerYear_F.Oth>0),
                      sum(detsPerYear_M.Oth>0))
  ##-- Total number of individuals detected
  numIds_sexYear <- c(numIds_sexYear,
                     sum((detsPerYear_M + detsPerYear_M.Oth) > 0) + 
                       sum((detsPerYear_F + detsPerYear_F.Oth) > 0))
  
  ##-- Combine in a data.frame
  numSamplesIds <- cbind.data.frame(
    "number of \ndetections" = numSamples_sexYear,
    "number of \nindividuals" = numIds_sexYear)
  rownames(numSamplesIds) <- c("female structured",
                               "male structured",
                               "female unstructured",
                               "male unstructured",
                               "Total")

    ##-- Print
  kable( numSamplesIds, 
         align = "cc",
         caption = paste0("Numbers of ", species," NGS detections and individuals detected included in the analysis. Numbers are reported by sex and for each monitoring period. One detection consists in at least one NGS detection of a given individual in a sub-detector grid cell and may thus correspond to multiple DNA samples collected. We included only samples collected within the study area during the primary monitoring period ", seasons, ".")) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = F)
}
```
